description: Published PCBWay sheet-metal/flatbed-cutting/hardware guidelines from an owner-supplied research snapshot (2026-10-23). Second-hand and provisional (the snapshot itself says entries need checking against the primary pages): every rule is non-blocking and can never produce a 'compatible' verdict.

research.notes: Data supplied by the project owner from an external research session; this project's build environment could not reach pcbway.com. Not a comprehensive or certified capabilities database; not PCBWay-approved. Unresolved: minimum hole size by material/process, thickness catalog by alloy, CNC tolerance tables, countersink/counterbore rules, tapping engagement, bend radius per alloy/temper, PEM catalog dimensions, bend-line vs bend-tangent datum, laser kerf per material.

processes.name: Sheet metal bending (published guidelines)

restrictions.text: Bend angles below 5 degrees or included angles above 130 degrees need manual review (special/near-flat bends, tooling access); no numeric rule is published.

source.note: Special/near-flat angles and tooling access require process interpretation; article cites bends below 5 degrees and included angles exceeding 130 degrees

rules.notes: Standard minimum bend height 4x thickness (smaller possible under special conditions). The datum is not published; the add-in measures from the bend tangent line, which is conservative. A separate PCBWay article states inside radius + 4T, which is stricter; both are preserved (see pcb.min_flange_radius_plus_4t) and not silently reconciled.
